preconditions.description: Input contains exactly four space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(int(x) > 0 and int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split())
preconditions.description: All four integers are positive and ≤ 10⁹.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == "-1" and not all(x == 1 for x in [int(x) for x in stdin.split()])) or (stdout.strip() != "-1" and all(x == 1 for x in [int(x) for x in stdin.split()]))
postconditions.description: If the input is already all 1s, output is empty. Otherwise, output is either '-1' (impossible) or a sequence of operations (≤ 1000 lines) that transforms the input to all 1s.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['/1', '/2', '/3', '/4', '+1', '+2', '+3', '+4'] for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()) if stdout.strip() != "-1" else True
postconditions.description: Each operation line is either '/X' (divide adjacent even numbers at positions X and X+1, with wrap-around) or '+X' (increment adjacent numbers at positions X and X+1, with wrap-around).

postconditions.expression: any(all(int(x) == 1 for x in [int(x) for x in stdin.split()]) or (stdout.strip() == "-1" and not all(int(x) == 1 for x in [int(x) for x in stdin.split()])))
postconditions.description: If the input is already all 1s, output is empty. Otherwise, output is '-1' only if no sequence of operations can reduce all numbers to 1.
